faqs.a: Pay-Per-Click (PPC) advertising shows your ads on Google, Meta and other platforms, and you pay only when someone clicks. It brings faster visibility than organic search.

faqs.q: Google Ads or Meta Ads: which is better?
faqs.a: Google Ads captures people already searching for what you offer. Meta Ads builds interest among people likely to need it. Most businesses get the best results using both.

faqs.q: How long before PPC campaigns show results?
faqs.a: Meaningful data usually appears within 30 to 45 days. Budget and bidding decisions become reliable at 60 to 90 days, once enough conversions have been tracked.

faqs.q: Why is my cost per lead so high?
faqs.a: Common causes are broad keywords, missing negative keywords, slow landing pages and untracked calls. Fixing tracking and targeting first usually lowers cost per lead.

faqs.q: How do you choose the best PPC agency in India?
faqs.a: Ask how they track calls and forms and cut wasted spend. The best PPC service in India for you reports cost per lead, not just clicks.

faqs.q: Why choose Reinvent Digital as your PPC company in India?
faqs.a: As a PPC company in India, Reinvent Digital builds campaigns around tracked enquiries, reviews performance weekly and moves budget to what brings qualified leads.
